name: X3: fix the 11 known test failures
description: Fixes the 10 failures in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and the 1 in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx so that npm test is fully green on the merged branch.

readFirst: scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and the docs or files it checks
the output of: npx vitest run scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx
extraGuardrails: EXCEPTION to the rule above, for this PRD only: you MAY edit scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx. Fix the cause (a stale doc, a renamed file, a changed schema) rather than weakening an assertion; if an assertion checks something that no longer exists on purpose (for example the removed library), update it to the new truth and say why in notes.

stories.title: Diagnose the 11 failures
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want each failure explained so that the fixes target causes.
steps: Run npx vitest run scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx and read every failure.
Write the cause of each failure in notes (one line each) and group them.
acceptance: notes lists all failing tests with a one-line cause each
No test file was edited in this story (git diff --stat on the two test files is empty)

stories.title: Fix the docs preflight failures
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts green so that the submission check passes.
steps: Fix each failure from US-001 in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts: update stale docs under docs/ or the paths the test reads.
Re-run npx vitest run scripts/preflight and confirm the rest of that folder still passes.
acceptance: No assertion was deleted or loosened: git diff on scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts shows each change explained in notes

stories.title: Fix the authoring agreement failure
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx green so that authoring and the schema agree.
steps: Fix the one failing test in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx at its cause (see US-001 notes).
Re-run npx vitest run web/src and confirm no other web test regressed.
acceptance: The change keeps the test's assertion meaning (explained in notes)

stories.title: Full run
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want the whole suite green so that every later PRD can trust npm test.
steps: Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test.
If any test still fails, fix its cause and re-run the full gate until it is green.
acceptance: npm test passes with zero failures
npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass
